newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche cautiously welcomes bank merger.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche cautiously welcomes bank merger.

text.p: Germany's largest bank, Deutsche Bank AG, on Monday cautiously welcomed the merger plans of Bayerische Vereinsbank AG and Bayerische Hypotheken- und Wechselbank.
Deutsche which last year unleashed a flurry of speculation in the banking sector by buying a 5.21 percent stake in Vereinsbank, said its purchase had proved "a good investment".
"As a shareholder in Vereinsbank we are watching the development with goodwill," a Deutsche spokesman said in answer to Reuter enquiries.
He declined to comment on whether the bank would raise or reduce its Vereinsbank stake in future.
The bank is likely to comment further on developments at a news conference to present its first half results on Wednesday.
